name: Detect Execution Bugs
description: Analyze MiniBob execution logs to detect systematic bugs, errors, and failure patterns that inhibit successful goal completion

log_file.description: Path to execution log file to analyze

error_threshold.description: Number of repeated errors to flag as systematic bug

tasks.description: Extract error messages from execution log

prompt.template:
Analyze these errors from MiniBob execution:

{{extract-errors.output}}

Identify:
1. Systematic bugs (errors repeating >{{error_threshold}} times)
2. Root causes (JSON escaping, memory issues, API errors)
3. Impact on goal completion
4. Recommended fixes

Format as structured report.

tasks.description: Analyze error patterns to identify systematic bugs
Check if goals were achieved despite errors

prompt.template:
Create bug report based on analysis:

Error Analysis:
{{analyze-patterns.output}}

Completion Status:
{{check-completion.output}}

Include:
- Bug severity (critical/high/medium/low)
- Reproduction steps
- Affected activities/tasks
- Suggested fix
- Workarounds

expected_outputs.name: bug_report
expected_outputs.description: Structured report identifying systematic bugs and recommended fixes

success_criteria: All error patterns identified and categorized
Root causes determined for systematic bugs
